title: They're In FIRST Place But Made A TERRIBLE Mistake #shorts
description:
Dune after dune, 35 pounds of water each - and they just took the lead.
Then they did the one thing you never do in a race: stopped to camp while rivals kept walking.
#Shorts #DesertSurvival #RaceDrama #ExtremeChallenge
